### 
8. Are NRIs eligible to enrol for Aadhaar? Are they allowed to use Aadhaar for banking, mobile, PAN and other services?
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
Aadhaar is not mandatory for school admissions or for the examinations conducted by the Central Board of Secondary Examination, National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for medical entrance or the University Grants Commission.
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
If any educational institution/ board insists on only Aadhaar as an identity document, you can show UIDAI’s [press release](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/press-release-06092018_0.pdf) - **Doc Type: PDF Size: 0.1MB** in the regard or complaint to the concerned authorities of the institution/ board.
